coffees.description: A bright and floral coffee with notes of jasmine, citrus, and sweet berries.
A rich and vibrant coffee with a full body and notes of blackcurrant, berries, and citrus.
A smooth coffee with low acidity and rich flavors of chocolate, nuts, and caramel.
A complex coffee with cocoa, spice, and dark chocolate notes with a pleasant smoky finish.
A clean and bright coffee with honey sweetness, citrus acidity, and a smooth finish.
A full-bodied coffee with earthy flavors, dark chocolate notes, and a subtle herbal finish.
A sweet and aromatic coffee with notes of red berries, honey, and gentle citrus acidity.
